mainEntity.name: Does DROS integrate with our core?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. DROS syncs delinquent accounts via CSV or API - balances, contact info, and payment history. There is no core migration and nothing changes in your system of record. Most credit unions are live within days.

mainEntity.name: Will members know they are talking to AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: DROS agents identify themselves per your disclosure requirements. Conversations are natural, patient, and scripted to your standards - members can always request a person, and those conversations route to your team instantly with full context.

mainEntity.name: How does this hold up in an NCUA exam?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every interaction is recorded, transcribed, and logged with timestamps, consent status, and disclosures. Your audit trail is a report you export, not a file you assemble.

mainEntity.name: What happens to our existing collections team?

acceptedAnswer.text: They stop dialing and start resolving. DROS handles the volume - first contacts, reminders, promise follow-ups - while your people take the hardship cases, disputes, and conversations that need judgment.

mainEntity.name: What does DROS cost for a credit union?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plans start at a flat monthly rate with included call minutes - no per-seat pricing, no long implementation fees. See pricing, or talk to us about your portfolio size.
